blocks.name: Yamcha (orange gi, scarred cheek) - NPC ally fighter
blocks.notes: Cells are 32x32 on the checkerboard #47ffbb/#34bc88; the surround is #2a966c and empty cells carry a #237f5a border - treat all four as transparent. The baked ground shadow is #000000, the same colour as outlines/eyes (and hair where black), so strip it by geometry, never by colour. The RIGHT row is a pixel-exact horizontal mirror of the LEFT row in every column. Every frame of a body on the floor sits in a ko* animation, which the build strips in its 'flat' shadow mode so black hair and eye lines touching the floor survive. Row lengths: down 29 (0-28), left/right 34 (0-33), up 29 with up col 1 empty (no back-view blink). Order: 0 idle, 1 blink, 2-5 walk (right step, pass, left step, pass), 6-9 punch string (6 fighting-stance wind-up, 7 straight jab with a white trail, 8 hook with a white arc, 9 follow-through with the arc's tail) - split into punch1 6-7 (wind-up, jab) and punch2 6, 8-9 (wind-up, hook, follow-through) so each string's second frame is its hit, 'combo' plays it whole; 10-13 kick string (10 knee chambered, 11 side kick with a white trail, 12 extended kick with the trail's tail, 13 knee retracted) - used as both punch3 and kick, like Goku's third string; 14-16 one-hand ki blast (14 wind-up stance, 15 front palm thrust, 16 rear palm thrust - loop 15-16 for rapid fire; facing up the thrusting arm points up the screen). 17-19 hurt/guard set: 18 hurt recoil (thrown back upright, face shaded, hit sparks); 17 and 19 are the same crouched duck-and-cover block with and without the white spark (19 carries it in every facing). 20 power-up stance (legs planted wider, arms held out, a couple of pixels lower than idle) - the engine draws the aura on top. 21-24 level-up cheer like Goku's 42-45: 21 both arms thrown straight up with sparkles, 22 wide-eyed with sparkles, 23 arms straight up, 24 wide-eyed near-idle (also 'surprised'). 25-28 flying (no baked shadow): side rows horizontal Superman pose, down row head-first toward the camera with the boots above the head, up row from behind with dangling legs. 29-32 (left/right only) knock-out: 29 struck upright, 30 thrown onto his backside, 31 landing on his back with a leg kicked up, 32 flat on his back (koHold). 33 (left/right only) 'koAlt': a second flat-on-his-back pose with the arm curled and the head lolled - use it for the defeated/unconscious hold. Baked effects: white trails in 7-9 and 11-12, two-size white sparks in 17-19 and 21-22. Palette overlaps: #000000 is hair, outlines, eyes and the baked shadow; the blue ramp is shared by the undershirt, wristbands, belt and boots; bootTrim greys are the boot cuffs and soles (#5a5a5a doubles as the eye grey). Stray #ce8463/#e7a542 single pixels in 22/24/32 are ripper residue.
